_comment: What the attendant at the gas station says, in the core's plain words: a setting says it in its own voice with
"replace" (a station.json in its own text). station.hint.<thing>.soon is a part that will need replacing
shortly, .now one that needs it now (AttendantCheck). {where} is the corner ("front left") or the axle ("front"), {car}
the car's short name, {oil} the oil short as station.oil_short.* says it ("a quart"). A pool with several lines says

station.greeting: Hello. What can I do for you?
station.greeting.towed: Ran out of fuel, huh? It happens. Let's fill it up.
The tow truck brought you in, I see. Let's get some fuel in it so it gets you home.
station.filled: All full. I cleaned the windshield too.
station.oil.low: I checked your oil: you're {oil} low.
The dipstick reads {oil} low. I'd put some in.
station.oil.very_low: Your oil is almost gone: {oil} low. Keep driving like that and the engine won't last.
You're {oil} low on oil. That engine is running nearly dry.
station.oil.ok: Your oil is right on the mark.
I checked your oil: it's fine.
station.oil.topped: Oil's topped up to the mark.
I put the oil in. It's full now.
station.all_good: Everything else looks good under the hood.
Belts, hoses, the rest of it looks fine to me.
station.hint.radiator.soon: Your radiator is starting to leak at the seams. It will need replacing soon.
station.hint.radiator.now: Your radiator is leaking badly. I wouldn't go far on it: it needs replacing now.
station.hint.water_pump.soon: The water pump is dripping. It will need replacing soon.
station.hint.water_pump.now: Your water pump is about to fail: there's coolant all over the front of the engine.
station.hint.fan.soon: The fan has a wobble to it. I'd have it looked at.
station.hint.fan.now: That fan is about to come apart. Replace it before it goes through the radiator.
station.hint.exhaust.soon: Your exhaust is starting to leak somewhere. You'll need a new one soon.
station.hint.exhaust.now: Your exhaust has a big hole in it. It needs replacing now.
station.hint.air_filter.soon: Your air filter is getting dirty. A new one is cheap.
station.hint.air_filter.now: Your air filter is clogged. The engine can hardly breathe: replace it.
station.hint.carburettor.soon: It's running a little rich at idle. The fuel system could use some work before long.
station.hint.carburettor.now: The fuel system is flooding: black smoke at idle and fuel where it shouldn't be. It needs work now.
station.hint.clutch.soon: Your clutch was slipping a little when you pulled in. It won't last forever.
station.hint.clutch.now: That clutch is slipping badly. Replace it before it leaves you stranded.
station.hint.engine.soon: I heard a little knock as you pulled in. I wouldn't push that engine too hard.
station.hint.engine.now: That engine is knocking loudly. Have it looked at before it lets go.
station.hint.gearbox.soon: I heard it crunch into gear on the way in. The gearbox is wearing out.
station.hint.gearbox.now: That gearbox is grinding badly. It has to come out and be rebuilt.
station.hint.tyre.soon: Your {where} tyre is getting thin. You'll want a new one soon.
station.hint.tyre.now: Your {where} tyre is bald. Replace it now.
station.hint.brakes.soon: Your {where} brakes squealed on the way in. They're wearing thin.
station.hint.brakes.now: Your {where} brakes are grinding metal on metal. Get them replaced before you need them.
station.hint.shocks.soon: The {where} end bounces a bit when I push on it. The shocks are getting soft.
station.hint.shocks.now: The {where} end keeps bouncing. Those shocks are worn out.
